## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one tracked problem.
- [ ] Commit messages follow the repository convention.
- [ ] Completed work is distinguished from planned work.
- [ ] Technical terms are explained at first use.
- [ ] Numerical claims have a reproducible source.
- [ ] Citations and source captions remain accurate.
- [ ] No unsupported academic result was introduced.
